description: Fix Instagram navigation issues: scroll triggering input, hashtag targeting, template automation

userStories.title: Fix scroll triggering text input
userStories.description: As the automation system, I need scroll actions to NOT trigger text input in the search field
acceptanceCriteria: Scroll actions use coordinates away from text input areas
Scroll starts from center of results list, not near search bar
After scroll, search query text is unchanged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Dismiss keyboard before scrolling
userStories.description: As the automation system, I need to dismiss the keyboard before scrolling search results
acceptanceCriteria: After typing hashtag, press BACK to dismiss keyboard
Verify keyboard is dismissed before proceeding to scroll/tap results
Add search.dismiss_keyboard action in skill flow
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added BACK dismiss step in planner prompt + search.dismiss_keyboard in instagram.skill

userStories.title: Improve hashtag result targeting
userStories.description: As the automation system, I need to tap hashtag results (starting with #) not account results
acceptanceCriteria: Planner prompt instructs to look for # prefix in results
Skill file has search.hashtag_result element with selector
Tap targets rows with # visible, not profile pictures
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Automate template copying in build
userStories.description: As a developer, I need skill templates to be copied to dist/ automatically during build
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build copies src/modules/skills/templates/*.skill to dist/modules/skills/templates/
Build script handles missing directories gracefully
Existing templates are overwritten
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add scroll coordinates to skill file
userStories.description: As the automation system, I need predefined scroll regions in the skill file
acceptanceCriteria: Add search.results_scroll_region with safe start/end coordinates
Start Y below search bar (y > 0.15)
End Y above nav bar (y < 0.85)
Scroll uses these coordinates instead of defaults
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: End-to-end test flow
userStories.description: Verify complete hashtag engagement flow works
acceptanceCriteria: Create test task: hashtag:#bucharest, 1 like
Task completes: search → type → dismiss keyboard → tap hashtag → scroll → like
No search field changed errors
No wrong screen errors
Task status shows completed

userStories.title: Fix like action for video/reels
userStories.description: As the automation system, I need to like posts correctly even when they are videos/reels with overlays
acceptanceCriteria: For videos/reels, tap the heart button instead of double-tap on image
Planner prompt instructs to use heart button for videos or when overlay is visible
Add post.heart_button element in skill file with coordinates
Handle 'Watch again' overlay state
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix nav.search coordinates triggering app switcher
userStories.description: nav.search at (0.7, 0.912) triggers Android app switcher instead of tapping Search tab. Need correct coordinates.
acceptanceCriteria: Update nav.search in learned_coords to x=0.5, y=0.91 (center, slightly higher)
Coordinates must NOT trigger Android gesture navigation
Test confirms tap opens Search/Explore screen
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current coords (0.7, 0.912) are too far right and too low - activates multitasking gesture

userStories.title: Rebuild and deploy after US-008 coord fix
userStories.description: US-008 committed but not deployed. Server still uses old coords. Need rebuild + pm2 restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Run npm run build
Run pm2 restart phone-network-server
Verify logs show nav.search coords as x=0.5, y=0.91
No typecheck errors

userStories.title: Clean failed tasks and create fresh test
userStories.description: Delete/pause all failed tasks, create one fresh #test task, start runner, verify completion
acceptanceCriteria: All failed/running tasks marked as paused via API
Create new task: hashtag:#test, 1 like, 2 min
Start task runner
Monitor until task completes or fails
Report final status

userStories.title: Clear device lock and restart task
userStories.description: Device 2cd08058 is marked busy but no task running. Clear the lock and restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Stop task runner
Clear device lock via API or pm2 restart
Reset task c5cd6628 to queued
Start task runner
Task should start executing
